thread:
lina: hi team, starting Monday — quick onboarding snag: i live in NZ and procurement says YubiKey shipping might be delayed customs. i can't use phone auth for a couple weeks (doctor's note). any workaround for MFA while waiting?
it-support: welcome Lina! we can provision a temporary VPN-only certificate and a limited-time app password, but need HR accommodation + security approval. what's the country and expected delivery ETA?
lina: country NZ, ETA unknown (seller gave 2-3 weeks). i've uploaded a redacted doctor's note to the accommodation form.
security: tagging for visibility. we generally don't issue long-lived app passwords; temporary certs for VPN-only are allowed with a mitigation plan and short TTL. please file the HR accommodation form and cc security@redwood.example.
lina: filed at https://redwood.example/hr/accommodation/1799991111 and cc'd security.
hr: got it @lina. We'll start the review. note that phishsim exclusion is separate — please indicate on the form if you need to be opted out.
procurement: on the shipping side, we can either ship a loaner YubiKey from our US stock or issue an express courier from AU partner. For customs, include "temporary business equipment" on invoice to avoid duties; we can do that if you confirm. DM address?
lina: yes please ship loaner from US stock, DM'ing address now. prefer express to avoid delays.
it-support: we'll prepare a loaner image (locked down) and a registration walkthrough. once you receive the key, register via Okta > Security > Add security key.
security: one more: temporary VPN cert will be issued only after HR sign-off and after you sign the temporary device/credential agreement. TTL will be max 10 business days. No access to sensitive payroll buckets with VPN-only cert.
lina: fine with that. timeline-wise, how fast can i get VPN cert?
it-support: if HR approves today, we can issue the cert within 4 hours (manual review window).
devops-bot: automated notice: new-hire onboarding checklist assigned to lina — InfoSec training will appear on day 2.
hr: once we finish, we'll notify security and it-support to proceed. also we'll mark phishsim opt-out for the approved period if requested.
lina: thanks folks! appreciate the expedited help, DM'd address. will update when YubiKey arrives.
